decisions.reason: Confirmed nonfatal citation/proof omission: F4 defines the inner-product axioms, not the Sobolev pairing. Proof 1.1 now proves integrability and representative independence, linearity of weak differentiation, bilinearity, symmetry, definiteness and exact norm equality before finite-product completeness and closed-kernel arguments. The original Definition is byte-unchanged.

F2 incorrectly attributed Countable Choice to coefficient completion. Corrected F2 and its owning choice-boundary record to restrict this assumption to the normalized-measure/integral/L2 realization. Checked shell summability, uniform derivative convergence, weighted finite-convolution inequality and completion/product agreement. Statement and thresholds are unchanged.

Confirmed nonfatal supplier-scope omission: the no-slip Definition covers only nonempty domains. Preserved the entire Statement including empty Omega; added the existing scalar Sobolev supplier, whose Definition explicitly gives the empty zero space, and proved this branch directly before invoking the nonempty vector supplier. Zero extension, the twice-integrated 2R estimate and H1-closure passage remain valid. Manifest dependency and contract updated under lock.

Confirmed nonfatal title overstatement: finite s>d/2+1 supplies C1, not Cinfinity. Renamed the title to periodic incompressible Sobolev velocity in carrier and manifest. The full Statement and proof are unchanged. Checked products in Hs and H(s-1), the negative Q sign, periodic product rule and uniqueness from zero Fourier coefficients using smooth-test convergence. No smoothness strengthening or hypothesis restriction was introduced.

Confirmed essential dependency-interface gap: fixed-support test continuity alone does not license a support-independent H1 bound or identify the recursive witness used by old proof 3.1. The supplier proof does contain the recursion, but its public Statement does not expose it. Repaired entirely inside this assigned theorem: 2.1 explicitly constructs and verifies the inverse; 4.1 proves its uniform H1 bound by primitive, marginal and tensor-product estimates, then extends pressure to H01 dual; 5.1 proves the equation, constant ambiguity, linearity and the inherited H1 product bound using the explicit Poincare dependency. No stronger claim is attributed to the unassigned supplier. Statement unchanged.
